text:
Amelia: Quick heads-up — I'm kicking off a FlashStream kernel experiment to compare fused vs split kernels on long-attn workloads. Need small runs for seq=2048/4096/8192 (also include 1024 baseline if easy), batch sizes 1/4/8 (drop if OOM), and kv-cache warm vs cold. Metrics: p50/p95 token latency, throughput (tokens/s), GPU mem, and kernel timeline. Patch: commit abc1234 on branch feat/flashstream-fuse. Can someone run this on dev-dedicated (a100-p2) today? Short runs, post traces + perf csvs.

Samir: I can take this on a100-p2. Do you want NVTX + Nsight (recommended) or just perf counters? Also, do you want raw CUDA timestamps or the runner's aggregated CSV? What's the minimum iterations/timeout?

Chao: +1 for Nsight for at least one config. Also grab the kernels list and kernel durations. Add env toggles: REDWOOD_ATTENTION_MODE=flashstream and FUSE_ATTENTION_OPS=(1|0). Example run snippet below — run once to warm KV then 3 timed iterations: 

```bash
export REDWOOD_ATTENTION_MODE=flashstream
export FUSE_ATTENTION_OPS=1
./perf_runner --model redwood-open-7b --seq 4096 --batch 4 --warm 1 --iters 3 --out=out/flashstream-4096-b4
```

Linh: I'll prepare a config JSON and a small wrapper to sweep seq/batch/cold-warm and upload to the perf runner. Suggest we include seq=1024 as baseline and note any p99 spikes. I'll push config to perf/flashstream-config branch.

Samir: Clarifying: "warm" means run a single generation to populate KV cache, then measure on subsequent runs, right? I'll run 3 iterations per config and post median + stdev. ETA ~2h for full sweep. @perf-bot please schedule the runs.

perf-bot: Perf run scheduled by Samir — run_id=flashstream-1979001234-1, node=a100-p2, configs=18, start_eta=1979002000. Logs will be uploaded to s3://redwood-perf/flashstream/1979001234/.

Amelia: Thanks — couple of small asks: 1) enable KERNEL_TRACE=1 for at least one run so we can map kernel names to durations, 2) include a baseline run on master (no patch) for seq=4096 batch=4, and 3) flag any p99 > 2x baseline. Also paste exact commands + S3 links in this thread.

Samir: Got it. Command I'll run: 

```bash
./perf_runner --config perf/flashstream-1979001234.json --repeat 3 --nvtx --nsys --env "KERNEL_TRACE=1" --out s3://redwood-perf/flashstream/1979001234/samir/
```

I'll fallback to batch=2 if OOM at seq=8192 and note it. Starting runs now, will post raw traces + csvs when done.

Chao: Note: the allocator tweak in abc1234 can change peak mem; run at least one master baseline for mem comparison. If you hit OOM for 8192, also try splitting into micro-batches and log the micro-batch timings.

Linh: Pushed perf config at perf/flashstream-config and opened PR #612. Includes configs, CSV extractor, and a small notebook to plot p50/p95.

Samir: Starting the sweep. Will update with links.

Amelia: :thumbsup: Thanks everyone — appreciate quick turn on this. If anyone notices a hard regression I'll follow up with an ASAP bisect plan.
